input_boundary: Owned complete finite initial source trial and the exact same owned image prelude; non-SVG multi-cell callers only; upstream accuracy qualification open

scope.source: clip_to_curve plus search_point_cloud and helpers, then native masked pre_mesh rebuild

predicates: Image scalar result !=0 exactly; no continuous allowance enters selection
Partial polygon requires some but not all nonzero vertices and nonzero centre
All-vertices branch does not require nonzero centre
Point cloud matching preserves every source occurrence and the strict1e-15m distance predicate
Convex clip helper uses strict left side; on-edge cases and all errors remain unchanged
source_geometry_distinctions: Pixel mask may contain holes; convex pixel hull does not
Source search returns(matched,unmatched): throw_away_pts receives hull matches, keeper_pts receives unmatched new intersections. Source raw ordering/duplicates remain.
clip_vor_verts are local intermediates. Final polygons come from centroid re-triangulation, not exact clipped polygons
occurrence_lineage: One derived centroid ID per source-emitting parent cell in source loop order, followed by exact masked-rebuild deletion indices; no nearest-coordinate identity recovery
cache_ownership: Reuse immutable typed numeric/object/ragged cache snapshots. Normalize live mask object into owned grid/curve token; do not export native objects
raw_retention: Actual State or rejected trial and full native trace saved before expectations; helper unexpected completions retained; cell/edge/search/intersection locals and source errors preserved

independent_diagnostics.mask: Manual Decimal bilinear values in closed image window only. Outside queries native-only, no extrapolation assumption
independent_diagnostics.half_planes: Exact binary-input rational signs; disagreements reported without changing native predicates or asserting universal selection correctness
independent_diagnostics.convex_intersection: All line-pair intersection candidates filtered by exact closed half-planes; source polygons/topology are inputs
independent_diagnostics.geometry: Decimal100/160 source geometry formulas, nearest distance/rank tables and line/polygon metrics; original source quad quantities remain distinct from general polygon geometry
independent_diagnostics.initial_primitive_coverage: Retained as unqualified upstream input; new budget assertions begin after clipping continuation marker
independent_diagnostics.binary_coefficient_domain: New clipping reference validates captured exact numeric0/1 float/int coefficients and converts to integers before qualified Decimal helper; reject other values/types without coercion/tolerance. Qualified image reference unchanged.

known_conditioning_issue: Initial square nearzero centroid and hex circumradius/inradius failed fixed budgets. No fixture/tolerance/source failure reclassification or retry; await Chief conditioning analysis.
qualification_preconditions: Chief scope/fixture review, including unqualified upstream accuracy and native-only outside-window mask scope
Resolve or explicitly bound the upstream conditioning limitation without tolerance widening
Prepare guarded driver/fresh production-denied replay and freeze; no launch until Chief directs
keeper_complement_witness: Explicit manufactured point-cloud witness asserts matched hull points discarded and unmatched intersections kept; required before branch credit.
